---
title: "Exploring storms"
author: ANgel Legrand
format: html
execute:
  echo: true
  
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: named-storms-per-year

storms |>
  filter(status %in% c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane")) |>
  mutate(status = factor(status, levels = c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane"))) |>
  count(year, status) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, fill = status)) +
  geom_area() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "tropical depression" = "lightblue",
      "tropical storm" = "orange",
      "hurricane" = "darkred"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Atlantic Storms by Type per Year",
    subtitle = "Annual count of tropical depressions, tropical storms, and hurricanes",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Storms",
    fill = "Storm Type"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: filter-recent-storms
#| cache: true

storms_recent <- storms |>
  filter(year >= 2000) |>
  select(year, name, status, wind, pressure)
```

```{r}
#| label: pressure-vs-wind

storms_recent |>
  ggplot(aes(x = pressure, y = wind, color = status)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Atmospheric Pressure vs. Wind Speed",
    subtitle = "Tropical storms and hurricanes (2000–2022)",
    x = "Air Pressure (millibars)",
    y = "Wind Speed (knots)",
    color = "Status"
  )
```
